show.title: The People's Saviour
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/ChVfgD
show.description: A humble village watchman secretly lives as a once-legendary master of divine power who vanished long ago. When an ancient, apocalyptic force returns to destroy the kingdom, his estranged son is forced to lead a doomed battle. With no hope left, the man must step out of the shadows, reveal his true identity, and unleash his forgotten power to defeat the darkness and save both his son and the world.
